output.explanation: Expanded runner because its captured SessionStep helper hides substantial per-invocation composition. The central diagram now separates service-owned resources, drain-local state, logical-step policy and attempt-owned resources. Two peripherals detail attempt execution/settlement and the publisher's state, fragment accumulators and publishing closures. Left core, state, requests, location and execution unchanged; they already separate shared peers from owned machinery. Checked the pinned checkout's instance graph, execution borrowing, runner, step, model-request and publisher implementations. Clarified that the runner wraps tool execution with the activation gate, the publisher also owns tool-input accumulators, flush timers are provider-child fibers, and successful Step.Ended publication belongs directly to attempt settlement rather than the publisher. Preserved all existing edges, relocating endpoints where details moved, and added ownership and interaction edges.

Durable state and admission: host-shared services

|   |-- Durable publish/publishAll transaction

|   |-- log(after, follow): retained history -> Synced watermark -> DB-backed tail

|-- SessionProjector: registers handlers with Bus (not owned by Bus)

|-- SessionInbox: pending user/synthetic inputs and compaction/move barriers

|       |-- steer eligible between steps
|       `-- queue eligible at next input/idle boundary
|-- InstructionEntry / InstructionState: durable session guidance

`-- SessionTransfer / SessionStats helpers

SessionExecution: host-owned execution machinery
[session/execution.ts; session/run-coordinator.ts; session/execution/subagent-report.ts]
|
|-- SessionRunCoordinator (constructed in SessionExecution's scope)
|   |-- Scoped FiberSet runtime
|   |-- executions: Map<SessionID, Execution>
|   |   `-- Execution: one process-local busy period per session
|   |       |-- owner fiber + done Deferred for joiners
|   |       |-- scope + pendingWake: coalesced input/steer doorbell
|   |       `-- stopping + interruptionReason
|   |-- Operations over that map
|   |   |-- run: start or join; stopping execution -> await then run fresh
|   |   |-- wake: start or ring doorbell; input scope subsumes steer
|   |   |-- interrupt: clear old wakes; acknowledge before cleanup completes
|   |   `-- settle: resolve joiners; late wake starts successor; awaitIdle rechecks
|   `-- Captured lifecycle callbacks
|       |-- started -> Bus.Execution.Started + Store.claim in one transaction
|       |   `-- -> report.started: bind startedSeq and current Job generation
|       |-- drain(sessionID): reload -> Store; borrow -> Instance.provide(session)
|       |   |-- -> SessionRunner.drain (location peer, not owned here)
|       |   `-- Moved/Reloaded -> reload placement and reacquire graph; carry continuation
|       `-- settled: one terminal observation per busy period
|           |-- Shutdown interruption -> publish Interrupted; preserve claim and running Job
|           `-- Other outcomes -> report.prepare -> Bus terminal with settlement.commit
|               `-- After commit -> settlement.deliver (best effort; outbox survives failure)
`-- SubagentReport coordinator
    |-- periods: Map<SessionID, {startedSeq, boundGeneration}>
    |-- prepare: consume period -> Job.prepareSubagentReport
    |   `-- Settlement closure
    |       |-- commit -> Store.release + Job report outbox in terminal transaction
    |       `-- deliver -> parent Inbox synthetic steer input; acknowledge via Job
    |           `-- -> coordinator.wake(parent), unless reverted or missing
    `-- Uses shared Store/Job/Inbox; owns no durable tables or Job fibers

SessionRunnerLLM: one service per cached location graph
[session/runner/llm.ts; step.ts; retry.ts]
|
|-- titles: scoped FiberMap<SessionID, fiber>
|   `-- Visible input for untitled root -> SessionTitle.generate; only if missing
|-- drain invocation: turn-local state, not a service per Session
|   |-- step, force, continuing, entering, stepped and promotable
|   |-- Entry -> Plugin.awaitActivation; settle stale compactions and tool calls
|   `-- advanceToStep closure + turn loop
|       |-- Closed location -> transport.close -> return Reloaded to Execution
|       |-- Inbox controls -> manual compaction or move; move returns Moved
|       |-- -> Context.select / InstructionState.prepare -> Inbox.promote -> Context.load
|       |-- Idle after a step -> idle hook; recheck Inbox before Complete
|       `-- Ready -> runStep; update turn state and repeat boundary
|-- runStep invocation: logical-step policy and retry loop
|   |-- assistantMessageID, initial context, recovery flags and retryAttempt
|   |-- SessionRunnerRetry helper: constructed for this logical step
|   |   `-- decide/wait -> retry hook / Bus.RetryScheduled; delay before retry
|   `-- Attempt preparation loop
|       |-- -> Context + Compaction: auto, precompute and overflow callback
|       |-- Retry refreshes context without promoting input; max steps -> toolChoice=none
|       |-- Prepared value: request/options/retry/executeTool; drops hook event copy
|       |   `-- executeTool wrapper -> activation gate -> captured Tool.Snapshot executor
|       `-- -> steps.attempt; interpret outcome -> retry/compact/continue or fail
`-- steps: SessionStep helper captured once (not a service or loop)
    |-- Captured references -> Bus, LLMClient, Snapshot, ToolOutput
    `-- attempt invocation: scoped resources, not shared between attempts
        |-- pendingStartSnapshot fiber -> Snapshot.capture
        |-- publisher: createLLMEventPublisher closure [detail: runner-publisher]
        |-- Provider consumer + toolRuns + settlement [detail: runner-attempt]
        `-- Outcomes -> runStep: Completed/Retry/RecoverFull/Compacted/OutputLimit

SessionStep.attempt: scoped execution and settlement
[session/runner/step.ts; publisher internals: runner-publisher]
|
|-- Invocation inputs: prepared request, model, IDs and runner callbacks
|   `-- executeTool already wraps activation; retry/overflow policy stays in runner
|-- pendingStartSnapshot: scoped capture fiber
|   `-- -> Snapshot.capture; overlaps request; joined before first provider event
|-- publisher handle -> owned per-attempt closure [detail: runner-publisher]
|-- providerStream: consumer of LLMClient.stream(request, options)
|   |-- Publish each event -> publisher; ignore events after providerFailed
|   |-- Tool.Called publication completes before local execution is forked
|   |   `-- providerExecuted calls have no local fiber; results arrive in stream
|   `-- Read through stream end; ensuring -> publisher.flush
|-- toolRuns: array of local call records
|   `-- Each record
|       |-- call: provider ToolCall
|       |-- cancel: Deferred gate + listener count + cancelled flag
|       |   `-- trigger signals cooperative stop only if a tool is listening
|       `-- scoped execution fiber
|           |-- Reject calls when toolChoice=none
|           |-- -> prepared.executeTool -> activation gate -> advertised Tool.Snapshot
|           |-- progress callback -> publisher.progress
|           `-- -> ToolOutput.truncate -> publisher.toolExecution; Tool.Error -> failTool
`-- Settlement block: uninterruptible bookkeeping, interruptible stream/tool waits
    |-- Stop on interrupt: user -> signal listeners; immediately interrupt other tools
    |   `-- Wait up to 5 seconds, then interrupt remaining tools; collect exits
    |-- Join tools before terminal events; classify declines, interruption and defects
    |-- Non-user daemon handoff interrupt, no declines -> leave step/calls unsettled
    |-- Recovery/retry callbacks -> runner; transparent recovery only before output
    |-- -> publisher: record failures; fail unsettled or incomplete calls
    |-- Finish or failure -> Snapshot.capture/files + SessionUsage.record
    |   `-- -> publisher.publishStepFailure or direct Bus Step.Ended
    `-- Return Outcome to runStep, or propagate failure/interruption

Per-attempt LLM event publisher: durable-event adapter, not a tool executor
[session/runner/publish-llm-event.ts; createLLMEventPublisher(bus, input)]
|
|-- Captured inputs: Bus.publish, IDs, model metadata, start time, pending snapshot
|-- Step state: started/first-token/output/provider-failure flags, failure and finish
|   |-- startAssistant -> await pending snapshot -> publish Step.Started once
|   |-- streamed / firstToken -> publish Step.Streamed / Step.FirstToken
|   `-- record() -> immutable StepRecord consumed by attempt settlement
|       `-- needsContinuation derives from local called or settled tool states
|-- tools: Map<callID, ToolState> (state only; fibers belong to attempt)
|   `-- Each state: name, called/settled/providerExecuted, progress, input excerpt
|       |-- Input excerpt bounded to 2048 characters; retains total length
|       `-- malformed flag -> differentiated malformed/truncated/incomplete failure
|-- Fragment accumulators: text, reasoning and toolInput
|   `-- Each accumulator: chunks Map + nextOrdinal + start/append/end/flush closures
|       `-- Fragment: ordinal, values, pending text, native metadata, optional timer
|           |-- Text/reasoning timer: provider-child fiber; batches deltas every 100ms
|           |-- End -> interrupt timer, publish remaining delta and full content
|           `-- Tool input end -> persist full arguments; retain bounded error excerpt
`-- Publishing closures over this state
    |-- publish(LLMEvent): uninterruptible event mapping -> Bus
    |   |-- New content block -> publish pending deltas before block start
    |   |-- Tool.Called / provider-hosted Tool.Success or Tool.Failed
    |   `-- step-finish -> flush fragments; store finish/usage (not Step.Ended)
    |-- progress / toolExecution <- local tool fibers; -> Bus tool events
    |-- flush / failTool / failUnsettledTools / failIncompleteTools
    |-- failAssistant records failure; publishStepFailure -> Bus Step.Failed
    `-- Concurrency: synchronous check-and-mark; per-source order, no writer queue
